Elena Park: Quick heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 10:00 AM PT (hybrid). Please join in-person in HQ Rm A or on Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/ah-tomorrow :calendar:
Elena Park: Draft agenda — 1) 5m company context + metrics, 2) product launches (Dedicated GA update), 3) infra & reliability highlights, 4) hiring + org updates, 5) live Q&A. Will keep it to 45m + 15m open Qs.
Elena Park: Drop any Qs below you want covered so we can surface them to execs ahead of time. If you need anonymity DM me or use the anonymous form in the calendar event.
Aj Chen: Can we add a 5m demo for the new routing policy UI? I think it's helpful for integrators. :eyes:
Elena Park: Yes — adding a 5m demo slot after product launches. Thanks @Aj.
Sanjay Rao: Will the session be recorded and captioned? I have team on APAC hours.
Maria Gomez: Recording + captions will be on Zoom by default. We'll also upload the recording and a short transcript to the all-hands notes doc.
Aj Chen: Any note on hybrid logistics — seating & catering? Moving teams around last minute is tough.
Maria Gomez: HQ Rm A capacity ~60. First-come seating. We'll have boxed lunches for folks in office (vegan & regular). If you need a special meal, ping me.
Elena Park: Also we plan to surface two customer stories during product — one short quote and one short demo. If any PMs want to add a datapoint, ping Aj.
Sanjay Rao: Added a question: will Dedicated GA include per-tenant observability metrics in the Console or just logs? Sharing in thread now.
Aj Chen: Noted — we'll aim to address the Console metrics plan in the product piece.
Elena Park: Thanks — keep the Qs coming. If you want to raise something sensitive, mention me privately.
ops-bot: Calendar event updated: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/ah-2026-03-24 (recording will be attached post-meeting)
Maria Gomez: Quick reminder — if you're joining in person, badge in at 9:45 to grab a coffee and seat. :coffee:
Elena Park: Final ask — if you have hiring referrals, bring names to the hiring update or drop them in #people-ops.
Aj Chen: Will we publish the slide deck? Useful to share post-meeting for teams that skip.
ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/recordings/ah-1782345678.mp4 — automated captions available. Transcript: https://files.redwood.example/transcripts/ah-1782345678.vtt
Elena Park: Recording & transcript live — thanks ops-bot! Key takeaways posted in #all-hands-notes shortly. If anything critical was missed, add to the doc or DM me. :sparkles:
